Philosophy & architecture of Mycelial Mind v2.0.0

**Mycelial Mind v2.0.0** (MC **1.21.1**, NeoForge **21.1.176**, Java **21**) replaces static difficulty with a persistent-memory hive (`HiveMindSavedData`).
Every damage stimulus (`StimulusType`) and tactical habit (`PlayerHabit`) recalibrates traits (`AdaptationTrait`), synergies, raids, and subterranean nodes.

Repeating one damage type fills its threshold (**70.0** at Tier 1 and effective **200.0** at Tier 2), hardening the swarm against that tactic.
Rotate melee, projectiles, fire, blasts, and magic; purge Nodes and craft countermeasures at the Synaptic Bench to bleed Hive memory.
